label: late original-phase steps (t=6-8, last 3 before <DEL>), boosted by j/z/1/e inputs or first token i
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase: 99% of activation mass is at t>=5, mostly t=6-8 in sequences with L>=7, within the last ~3 tokens before <DEL>. It never fires at t<=3, is weak on the <DEL> step, and never fires in the copy phase. Within that window it is sparse: the positional condition alone has 3% precision. The rate goes up when the current input is j, z, 1 or e (lift 3-6x) and when the sequence starts with i (7.5x). The top examples mostly start with i, followed by k/t/m and then t. The combined predicate still has low precision (~17% on dev), so the content that decides which late steps fire is only partly captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=i (+3.49), orig2=t (+2.85), orig1=t (+2.60), orig1=k (+2.02), t=7 (+1.83), orig3=t (+1.78). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-7.55), t=4 (-5.72), phase=2 (-5.11), orig0=x (-5.01).
